title: Line sketch: Cosmic Spiral Dance
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: This abstract composition centers on a large circle with concentric rings and a surrounding orbit, encircled by curved forms, scattered dots, and organic shapes. The design radiates outward in balanced layers against a background, creating a sense of dynamic movement and cosmic harmony. Bold black outlines enclose flat, vibrant color fields with clean edges and minimal shading (derived from painting #105).
